title: 第1373章 融合不死之体第1372章 太迟了
content_zh:
“不好，这老东西拼命了，献祭了道果。”
鸿钧惊骇，圣君四重献祭还是很可怕的，战力会一下子暴涨数百倍不止！
“如果一开始你就拼命跟俞陀联手，兴许还真有希望翻盘。
可惜现在太晚了。”
林炎咬破指尖，一滴暗红色的血液滴落在了暗天矛之上。
这一滴暗红色血液使得暗天矛上浮现出了一道道暗红色的花纹，看起来无比可怖。
那是当年红瑶圣尊烙印下来的神文！
唯有不死之体，才能唤醒！
此刻林炎融合了不死之体的本源之力，已然能够发挥出部分力量。
轰的一声，血色长矛戳了出去。
那冰蓝色的太阳还没有升腾到极点，就被粉碎了。
咔嚓，就如同是一块冰雕破碎，无数的冰晶炸开，冰元的身躯从其中跌落了下来。
“怎么会这样？哪怕是殿主大人年轻的时候，也做不到这一点吧！”
冰元一脸惨然。
他知道林炎强，但没想到强到这种程度，仅仅是一矛而已，就破了他燃烧道血献祭来的杀招。
“去死吧！”
暗天矛砸了下来，直接将冰元砸碎成了肉泥。
一道残魂欲要逃出，林炎则是直接施展九龙吞天诀将其吞噬。
一瞬间，林炎得到了冰元的诸多记忆。
从这些记忆之中，林炎得到了很多的信息。

其中还有一条比较重要的消息：圣殿派遣了不少强者进入冥界之中。
这些人的目的是为了救援一位来自圣族的圣尊级强者。
没想到居然还有活着的圣族圣尊。
林炎心头一惊，按照冰元得到的情报，那位圣尊当初是跟着大部队一同入侵冥界的，甚至还参与了围剿红瑶圣尊。
可惜最终被红瑶圣尊封印了起来，而红瑶圣尊也在众人的围攻之中重伤沉睡了。
不久之前冥界狱门开启，圣域那边的大人物，便是察觉到了这尊活着的圣尊，立刻就给圣殿发下了消息。
只因如今圣族无法侵入大宇宙之中。
如果能让那位圣尊活下来，恢复到巅峰时期七七八八，到时候整个洪河星域都将会沦为圣族掌控之中。
圣族这群该死的混蛋，这个时候了还给大宇宙添乱。
得知消息后，流光圣殿和苍天道火等都不禁暗骂。
如今两大宇宙几乎要碰撞在一起，随时可能造成灭世大劫，圣族在这个时候还想趁火打劫，简直可恨至极。
“我会想办法阻止的，不过前提是先将大宇宙的劫给解开了。”
林炎沉声说道。
如今两大位面世界的力量碰撞在一起，已经有更多的时空裂缝。
再这样下去，要不了多久，两大世界便会轰然崩溃，到时候将会是无数的生灵陨灭。
“以你的修为，想要阻挠还是很难的，除非能将红瑶圣尊唤醒。”
暗天矛说道。
“红瑶圣尊能挽救两大位面世界吗？”
林炎询问。
“当然可以，红瑶圣尊可是超脱境强者，这个级别的存在能够改天换地，破灭宇宙。

将两大位面世界分开，对圣尊而言不算什么。”
“既然如此，那我就想办法唤醒红瑶圣尊。”
林炎深吸一口气，做出决定。
他的思绪回到了现实中。
随着冰元陨落，整个藏宝库内都一片寂然。
content_en:
"No, this old guy tried his best and sacrificed the Dao Fruit."
Hongjun was horrified. The fourth level sacrifice of the Holy Lord was still very terrifying. The combat power would suddenly increase hundreds of times!
"If you had joined forces with Yu Tuo desperately from the beginning, there might be hope for a comeback.
Unfortunately it's too late now. "
Lin Yan bit his fingertip, and a drop of dark red blood fell on the Dark Sky Spear.
This drop of dark red blood caused dark red patterns to appear on the Dark Sky Spear, which looked extremely terrifying.
That was the divine inscription imprinted by Saint Hongyao back then!
Only the immortal body can be awakened!
At this moment, Lin Yan had merged the original power of the immortal body and was able to exert some of his power.
With a bang, the bloody spear poked out.
The icy blue sun was shattered before it reached its peak.
With a click, it was like an ice sculpture shattering, countless ice crystals exploded, and Bing Yuan's body fell from it.
"How could this happen? Even the Lord of the Palace couldn't do this when he was young!"
Bing Yuan looked miserable.
He knew that Lin Yan was strong, but he didn't expect him to be so strong. Just one spear was enough to defeat his killing move of burning Dao blood as a sacrifice.
"Go to hell!"
The dark sky spear smashed down, directly smashing the ice element into pulp.
A remnant soul wanted to escape, but Lin Yan directly used the Nine Dragons Swallowing Heaven Technique to devour it.
In an instant, Lin Yan obtained many memories of Bing Yuan.
From these memories, Lin Yan obtained a lot of information.
There is also a more important piece of news: the temple has sent many strong men into the underworld.
The purpose of these people is to rescue a saint-level powerful man from the saint clan.
Unexpectedly, there is still a living Saint Lord.
Lin Yan was shocked. According to the information obtained by Bing Yuan, the Holy Lord invaded the underworld with the large army, and even participated in the encirclement and suppression of the Holy Lord Hongyao.
Unfortunately, it was eventually sealed by Saint Hongyao, who was also seriously injured and fell asleep amid the siege.
Not long ago, the prison gate of the underworld was opened. The big shots in the sanctuary noticed the living saint and immediately sent a message to the temple.
Just because the saints cannot invade the universe now.
If the Holy Lord can be allowed to survive and return to his peak state, then the entire Honghe Star Region will be under the control of the Holy Clan.
These damn bastards from the Saint Tribe are still causing chaos to the universe at this time.
After learning the news, Liuguang Temple and Cangtian Daohuo couldn't help but curse secretly.
Now the two universes are almost colliding together, which may cause a catastrophe at any time. It is extremely hateful for the Saints to still want to take advantage of the situation.
"I will find a way to stop it, but the prerequisite is to solve the catastrophe of the universe first."
Lin Yan said in a deep voice.
Now that the forces of the two worlds collide, there are already more cracks in time and space.
If this continues, it won't be long before the two worlds collapse suddenly, and countless living beings will perish.
"With your level of cultivation, it will be very difficult to stop you, unless you can awaken the Holy Lord Hong Yao."
Dark Sky Spear said.
"Can Saint Hongyao save the two worlds?"
Lin Yan asked.
"Of course, Saint Hongyao is a powerful person in the transcendent realm. An existence of this level can change the world and destroy the universe.
Separating the two worlds is nothing to the Holy Lord. "
"In that case, then I will find a way to awaken Saint Hongyao."
Lin Yan took a deep breath and made a decision.
His mind returned to reality.
As Bing Yuan fell, the entire treasure house fell into silence.
